title: Chapter 6643: Can’T Become The Lord Of All Things With This Dao Heart

Chapter 6643: Can’T Become The Lord Of All Things With This Dao Heart

Chapter 6643: Can’t Become The Lord Of All Things With This Dao Heart

World City turned into a paradise with the embedded treasure.

“You have a long way to go before becoming the Lord of All Things or an immortal.” Li Qiye pulled the spring of fortune toward him with both hands.

The liquid that had seeped into the world and its inhabitants was forcefully removed. Keep in mind that primal ancestors or heaven-slayers couldn’t remove the fusion from themselves.

However, Li Qiye did it on the highest scale. The liquid came together and formed a boundless ocean in the air.

This time, it was no longer coveted by the crowd. The benefits didn’t outweigh the cons for them.

Li Qiye gathered all the liquid regardless of Li Xingchen’s will. He forced them back into the spring and refined it into a well.

The artificial space also resembled bees returning to their hive, which was the well in this case. Its size and stars mattered not; Li Qiye still forced them to move.

The world became normal after their disappearance. Bright sun rays illuminated Heaven World once more.

“Bam!” Li Qiye pushed down and sent the well of creation into World City’s chasm. With that done, he entered before closing the chasm entirely.

“It’s over.” Everyone contemplated the events. It felt like a dream, especially for the competitors who had a good view of everything.

“Hahaha, I’m free!” Liu Sanqiang still celebrated his new life.

Dugu Yuan and the others stared at him, speechless. The imperious Calamities showed no sign of unhappiness after losing his cultivation.

***

Li Qiye sat by the well in the center of World City. Within was a stone egg embedded with stars. Within was a lifeform unlike any other.

Li Qiye picked it up and carved on the shell using his finger. He moved swiftly and precisely like a dragon, scribing a supreme grand dao. Once finished, he tapped it and sent the dao into the egg.

The egg had no choice but to obey as it was nourished by the water in the well. The dao within started changing. A tiny rune created a larger one, and then the next one was larger...

They wanted to form a chapter containing a unique dao of its own. Eventually, they emitted a beautiful primordial light as if this were the start of a primordial world.
